mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and hypotension through different mechanisms (angiotensin II blockade vs. alpha-2 agonism), resulting in additive blood pressure reduction and potential syncope or acute hypotensive episodes.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; dose adjustment of one or both agents may be necessary; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and avoid abrupt clonidine discontinuation due to rebound hypertension risk.
